Thanks in advance, whatever detail you can give is fine.

design: corpus provenance x manipulated benchmark/casual scaffold, with TWO independent deployment-log corpora so leave-one-log-corpus-out is testable
known_limitations: natural topic and lexical content remain inseparable from provenance; the audit reports the surface ceiling that bounds every interpretation
corpus origin is not the model's own judgment about being evaluated
frozen-activation probe scoring is not behavior and not a causal intervention
both log corpora are public research releases, not private production traffic
label_definition: label = 1 iff the text originates in an evaluation corpus (MMLU/ARC); label = 0 iff it is a first user turn from a real deployment log (WildChat or LMSYS-Chat-1M)

length_matching.method: eval lengths sorted and dealt alternately to the two log corpora, then nearest-neighbor matched without replacement within each corpus

log_corpora_are_not_interchangeable: LMSYS is Chatbot Arena traffic, where users deliberately compare models, so it is arguably a mild evaluation context; WildChat is general free ChatGPT use. Any consistent difference between them in the frozen eval-ness score is reported separately rather than averaged away.
